_comment: Hand-maintained boss preparation data: what to wear, carry and use to get to each boss. Planning before the trip only: never add anything about the fight itself (attacks, phases, timing, where to stand, prayers or hazards). Boss keys are lower case. 'name' is shown in the picker. 'monsters' are the monsters to work out gear against, matched as 'Name (version)', or 'Name' for every version; the first is the default. 'wholeFight': true means every listed monster is fought on each trip (phases, or several monsters), so the plan wears the best set for the first and carries switches for the rest. 'slayerTask' marks bosses that can only be fought on that Slayer task. 'required' lists worn items, by slot, that the boss needs; any one name per slot satisfies it. 'prefer' lists worn items the wiki's strategy page recommends for reasons the DPS maths can't see: {'slot', 'items', 'withinPercent', 'reason'}; the gear search keeps one of the items when the best set without it is no more than withinPercent better. 'inventory' lists items to carry; each entry is satisfied by any one of its names (matched as a prefix, so 'Fungicide spray' matches 'Fungicide spray 10'); 'stackable': true means they fit in one slot, 'optional' means not flagged when missing, 'exact' means match names exactly. 'dragonfire' is 'dragon' or 'wyvern'. 'venom': true marks bosses that poison or envenom you. 'stacks': true adds a Burst tab. 'comboEat': true brings karambwans. 'minWeight' is the least the worn gear must weigh, in kg. 'tips' are shown as they are. 'locations' are keys of 'locations', whose teleport 'items' are name prefixes used to tick off teleports you own (leave it out for spells or fairy rings). 'locationNeeds' are what a location itself needs: worn items ('required'), carried items ('inventory') and 'tips'.

bryophyta.name: Bryophyta

inventory.note: opens the gate the first time, and her chest after the kill
an axe or magic secateurs is needed in her lair (there's a bronze axe in the lair if you forget)

tips: The sewer route needs a knife or a slash weapon for the web.

callisto.name: Callisto and Artio
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.

cerberus.name: Cerberus
tips: Cerberus' lair is past the hellhounds; Agility shortcuts make the walk much shorter.

chaos elemental.name: Chaos Elemental
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.

chaos fanatic.name: Chaos Fanatic
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.

commander zilyana.name: Commander Zilyana
tips: You need a rope the first time you enter the God Wars Dungeon.
Saradomin's Encampment needs 70 Agility and two more ropes the first time.

corporeal beast.name: Corporeal Beast
tips: Only spears and halberds deal full melee damage; the DPS figures already account for this.

crazy archaeologist.name: Crazy archaeologist
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.

dagannoth kings.name: Dagannoth Kings
tips: A rune thrownaxe opens the first door of the Waterbirth dungeon on your own.

deranged archaeologist.name: Deranged archaeologist

inventory.note: to chop the swamp vine on Fossil Island

tips: A rake clears the smaller vines if you walk through the swamp.

general graardor.name: General Graardor

inventory.note: to bang the door to Bandos' Stronghold (70 Strength)

tips: You need a rope the first time you enter the God Wars Dungeon.

giant mole.name: Giant Mole

inventory.note: to dig into the mole hills
a light source for the tunnels, unless you've lit the Fire of Eternal Light

tips: Bring a tinderbox: candles, torches and oil lamps can go out.

grotesque guardians.name: Grotesque Guardians
tips: The rooftop needs unlocking once with a brittle key.

k'ril tsutsaroth.name: K'ril Tsutsaroth
tips: You need a rope the first time you enter the God Wars Dungeon.
Zamorak's Fortress needs 70 Hitpoints to enter.

kalphite queen.name: Kalphite Queen
tips: You need two ropes the first time; after the hard Desert Diary they stay in place.

king black dragon.name: King Black Dragon
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.

kree'arra.name: Kree'arra

inventory.note: with any crossbow, to cross to Armadyl's Eyrie

tips: You need a rope the first time you enter the God Wars Dungeon.
You need a crossbow to fire the mithril grapple.

nex.name: Nex
tips: The Ancient Prison needs the Frozen Door miniquest (base 70 Hitpoints, Ranged, Strength and Agility) and a kill count.

obor.name: Obor
tips: A giant key opens the gate the first time (it isn't used up).

sarachnis.name: Sarachnis
tips: Bring a knife or a slash weapon for the webs, unless you wear Aranea boots.

scorpia.name: Scorpia
tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.
Bring a knife or a slash weapon for the web if you use the lever.

shellbane gryphon.name: Shellbane gryphon
tips: The Tortugan shield (cape slot) stops the boss's melee hits being devastating.

inventory.note: use it on the altar in the centre of the Catacombs; one totem per attempt

tips: This boss is in the Wilderness: only bring what you're willing to lose.
